|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Maneuvering Flaps (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, you may reveal one unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to take its matching pilot character from Reserve Deck (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to take its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' removed “you”; “one” → “an”; removed “from Reserve Deck”; “simultaneously;” → “simultaneously into hand from Reserve Deck;”; “[Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 12. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Maneuvering Flaps]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Maneuvering Flaps (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Maneuvering Flaps]]. Code OVS4 · GEMP id 1104_12.
